name: simple_smoke_puff_basic
code_snippet:
# domain settings
domain.modifiers['Fluid'].domain_settings.resolution_max = 32
# flow settings
flow.modifiers['Fluid'].flow_settings.flow_type = 'SMOKE'
# simple volume material
mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name='SmokeVolume')
mat.use_nodes = True
nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
links = mat.node_tree.links
nodes.clear()
from_node = nodes.new(type='ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled')
from_node.location = (0,0)
vol_info = nodes.new(type='ShaderNodeVolumeInfo')
vol_info.location = (-200,0)
output = nodes.new(type='ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
output.location = (200,0)
links.new(vol_info.outputs['Density'], from_node.inputs['Density'])
links.new(from_node.outputs['Volume'], output.inputs['Volume'])
context_after: added domain resolution, flow type, and simple volume shader
